svg.title: Fabric Spark Data Engineering Architecture
svg.desc: Notebooks and Spark job definitions request managed Spark sessions. Capacity and pool configuration determine startup and resources. A driver schedules executor work with autoscale. Native execution can accelerate supported operators. Write optimization, V-Order, and compaction shape Delta files on OneLake.
svg.text: Starter or custom pool — Starter pools favor quick defaults; custom pools expose size and scaling controls.Fabric Data Engineering — Spark Architecture

Notebook and job entry — Notebooks support interactive engineering; Spark job definitions package production execution.Notebooks · Spark Job Definitions · Pools (Starter / Custom / Autoscale) · Delta on OneLake · Optimized Write · V-Order · Auto Compaction
Not a replacement for complex notebooks
Installs libs at session start (+30 s – 5 min)
Node size fixed: Medium (8 vCores / 64 GB)
Unavailable with Managed VNet / Private Links
Scales between min and max node count
Grows when tasks exceed current capacity
Releases executors as work completes / idles
Executors and autoscale — Worker executors process partitions while autoscale and dynamic allocation adjust resources.POOL INTERNALS (every node type)
Driver + single executor on single-node pools
flushes in-flight tasks before node removal
Execution and file layout — Native execution and write optimizations improve supported processing and Delta layout.Optimized Write
BinSize default 1 GB; tune 256 MB / 128 MB
Delta on OneLake — Spark writes engineered output into versioned Delta tables on OneLake.V-Order + Auto Compaction
All Fabric Workloads Read the Same Delta Files
Warehouse · SQL Analytics Endpoint · Power BI Direct Lake
No data copies needed — single source of truth in OneLake

Capacity vCore budget — Fabric capacity bounds the Spark resources available to concurrent sessions.Billing: active execution only — idle pre-warm, cluster acquisition, Spark context init, and post-job deallocation are all unbilled (starter and custom pools).

Driver and scheduler — The driver builds jobs, stages, and tasks and coordinates executor work.Warning: X-Large and XX-Large node sizes require non-trial Fabric SKUs. Managed VNet / Private Links disable starter pools entirely.
